name: Moonglade
summary: In Darnassus, young night elf druids learn to reach Moonglade. Mathrengyl Bearwalker teaches novices a spell to carry themselves across the world into Moonglade, where they meet Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven. There begins their path toward mastering bear form.

sections.title: A Sacred Refuge
sections.body: Moonglade is an ancient sanctuary apart from the rest of Azeroth, devoted to the teachings of Cenarius. Keeper Remulos watches over its groves, where druids find peace and communion with nature. Young druids learn a spell that lets them carry themselves across the world into Moonglade, reaching a heart of druidic wisdom beyond mortal distances.

sections.title: Politics of the Circle
sections.body: Moonglade welcomes all who follow the wild, though the Cenarion Circle knows its share of tension. In Darnassus, Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm and Keeper Remulos disagree over nature’s care and the creation of Teldrassil. Their differences do not close Nighthaven to young acolytes, who are welcomed to pursue their studies.

sections.title: The Path of the Bear
sections.body: In Nighthaven, Dendrite Starblaze guides young druids in the ways of the Claw. Before an initiate can take up the bear’s mantle, the trials teach the bear’s endurance, fury, and defense of the wild. Starblaze welcomes each student in reverence to Father Cenarius as the trials of the Great Bear Spirit begin.

faq.q: Why do druids learn to teleport to Moonglade?
faq.answer: The spell gives druids a way to return to Moonglade, where training, communion with spirits, and high-level council take place in Nighthaven. Its instant passage lets each practitioner return to study and replenish spiritual energies.
Dendrite Starblaze is an elder druid on the upper floor of a major lodge in Nighthaven. He oversees arriving initiates and begins their trials in animal perspectives, starting with the bear.

faq.q: What tensions exist between Fandral Staghelm and Keeper Remulos?
faq.answer: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm led the planting of Teldrassil without the Dragon Aspects’ blessing and pursued a more aggressive, nationalistic path for the night elves. Keeper Remulos and Moonglade’s traditionalists hold to Cenarius’s ancient, neutral ways, bringing ideological friction to the Cenarion Circle.

faq.q: Can Horde druids visit Moonglade as well?
faq.answer: Yes. Moonglade is a neutral haven under Keeper Remulos and the Cenarion Circle. Night elf and tauren druids study the wild ways together there, setting aside factional hostility within Cenarius’s peace.

faq.q: What happens after reaching Dendrite Starblaze?
faq.answer: After you reach Dendrite Starblaze, he guides you into the ritual trial of the Great Bear Spirit. The spiritual confrontation tests your resolve and understanding before you can wield the bear’s power.

faq.q: Where in Nighthaven is Dendrite located?
faq.answer: Dendrite Starblaze is inside the main night elf lodge near the center of Nighthaven, on its second-floor balcony overlooking the village.

angles.text: As a druid, this journey awakens you to a wider druidic heritage and gives you an eternal lifeline to the tranquil heart of the Cenarion Circle.
As a night elf, leaving Teldrassil’s boughs for ancient Moonglade connects you with the ancestral homeland preserved before the Great Sundering.
As an Alliance member, entering Moonglade reminds you that night elf druids answer to an older calling beyond worldly factions.
